name: XTUSD
oneLiner: XTUSD is XT.com/XSC's MakerDAO-style vault dollar, minted against overcollateralized XTDao crypto vaults with limited public on-chain tooling for Pharos.
collateral: Overcollateralized XTDao vault collateral on XSC; issuer materials describe XT as the initial collateral asset with protocol support for additional collateral over time, but public live collateral composition remains hard to verify without XSC tooling.
pegMechanism: XTDao CDP: users mint XTUSD against overcollateralized vaults; risky vaults are auctioned to keep collateral above outstanding debt. Secondary market and account liquidity run through XT.com, and Pharos does not model a fiat cash redemption window.

oracleRisk.summary: XT.com documents XTUSD as an XTDao vault system with collateral auctions, but public issuer materials do not identify the price oracle, feed source, or failover path used for vault collateral on XSC.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: XTUSD resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

notices.title: Non-indexed issuance chain
notices.message: XTUSD primarily circulates on XSC, which is not EVM-indexed by Pharos. No on-chain contract is stored; supply and metadata are supplemented by external sources only.

notices.title: Redemption backstop not modeled
notices.message: XTUSD is tracked from market and issuer metadata, but Pharos has not source-reviewed a public holder redemption route for backstop scoring.

mintAuthority.summary: XTUSD is described by XT.com as an XTDao/MakerDAO-style vault stablecoin, with users minting against protocol collateral while DAO/protocol governance controls collateral parameters; the on-chain XSC admin remains unresolved.

controls.label: XTDao vault/protocol mint route
controls.capDescription: XTUSD minting is described as a MakerDAO-style vault route bounded by collateral and auctions; on-chain XSC cap/admin verification remains unresolved.
controls.evidence: XT.com's TAI-to-XTUSD announcement describes XTUSD's economic system as an XTDao smart-contract project based on MakerDAO, with vault collateral and auctions used to keep enough collateral against outstanding debt.

controls.label: XTDao collateral-parameter governance
controls.evidence: XT.com's announcement describes XTDao as the governance/protocol layer that can support multiple collateral assets over time, making the mint path user-collateralized but parameter-governed.

review.evidence: XT.com's first-party TAI-to-XTUSD announcement describes XTUSD as built on an XTDao smart-contract project based on MakerDAO. XSC (XT Smart Chain) is not EVM-indexed by any public keyless RPC or explorer API accessible in this environment; no public XSC block explorer with programmatic access was found. On-chain verification of vault contracts, owner/admin, pause, and upgrade authority is not possible without chain-specific tooling.
unresolvedQuestions: XSC chain has no publicly accessible keyless RPC or block explorer API; on-chain verification of XTDao vault owner/admin requires either direct XSC node access or a public XSC explorer with contract read support.
